text:
I've finished reading for G4 and am writing up the finding now.

The probe list does stop at P-CC-12, as the triage note says. The new probe would be P-CC-13. Three things in the repository have to agree on that count.

ARTIFACT gap_finding: Probe list stops at P-CC-12 (verified). `plugins/tempergraph/docs/specs/executor-claude-code.spec.md`: ECC-B13 (lines 97-99) names P-CC-1 to P-CC-9 inline; P-CC-10 and P-CC-11 sit in ECC-B14 (line 105); P-CC-12 is named only by ECC-B16/ECC-AC10, and ECC-AC5 (line 138) covers ECC-B13 probe results. The Open questions item at line 149 reads "Not built yet: probes P-CC-1 to P-CC-12 have not been confirmed on the owner's machine. Owner: engine owner." ECC-B8, ECC-B9 and ECC-B10 are the behaviours the new probe would confirm; only ECC-B13 lists probes. `plugins/tempergraph/docs/plans/live-checks.plan.md`: section 3 rows run L-0 to L-42 in the columns Row|Check|Test|A pass looks like|Then update. P-CC-1 is L-1 (line 24), P-CC-10 is L-31 (line 34), P-CC-12 is L-42 (line 71, the last row). Section 4 Results (from line 73) uses Row|Date|CLI version|Result|Notes. L-42 is at line 118 and the section's trailing paragraph is at line 120. P-CC-11 has no section 3 row. It has a results row at line 111 named by probe id, so a result row can be named P-CC-13 or L-43. Code that counts probes: `plugins/tempergraph/engine/src/tempergraph/executors/claude.py:501` builds `LIVE_FACTS` from `range(1, 13)` with every probe "not run"; `plugins/tempergraph/engine/src/tempergraph/data/executor_compat.json:8` says "P-CC-1 to P-CC-12 not yet run". Both need the new count. Plan r3-t1-2.plan.md rows 2.5 and 2.6 did the same for P-CC-11, and its handoff says no test pins the count. Not found: any existing P-CC-13 or connector probe text. The spec states the new rule (G1 to G3) in ECC-B8, ECC-B9 and ECC-B10 and does not add it to ECC-B13's inline list. Earlier probes were added to ECC-B13 or ECC-B14 by id.
